title: Absence of bounded-orbit wandering domains
summary: We formalise the proof of two major recent results on wandering domains of transcendental entire and meromorphic functions: every orbit in a wandering domain accumulates at infinity and at a non-isolated (derived) point of the spherical set of singular values. Both results are obtained as a special case of a more general theorem, for locally defined functions on possibly disconnected complex one-manifolds.
